observations: Exercise bike with a digital display and control panel at the handlebars.
Orange and white color scheme on the pedals and handlebar console.
The bike is standing on a green artificial turf background.
A watermark 'NAMISDY ENTERPRISES POSTED ON JIJI' is visible across the center of the image.

claims.evidence: The bike appears clean in photo 0, but 'fair used' is a subjective term for used goods.

claims.claim: Bought new 6 months ago. Gears and brakes perfect, no rust, all parts original.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The digital display may be dead or have a broken screen.
risks.proof: A photo of the screen powered on showing the workout metrics.
risks.if_unproven: as a bike without a working display

risks.risk: The pedals may be loose, worn, or have a broken clutch.
risks.proof: A video showing the pedals being turned by hand.

risks.risk: The internal resistance mechanism (gears) may be non-functional.
risks.proof: A video showing the resistance dial being turned and the speed increasing.

risks.risk: The electronic control panel may have a faulty button or switch.
risks.proof: A video showing the console being operated to change settings.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Photo of the screen powered on showing the display and buttons.
Video of the pedals being turned by hand to check for play.
Video of the resistance dial being turned and the speed increasing.
Photo of the pedals and the resistance mechanism.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
